deadline.value: Students should apply by Jan 1 for fall admission.
deadline.quote: Students should apply by Jan 1 for fall. There is no spring intake for this program.

gre_general.value: GRE is required for all applicants; waived for WPI students and alumni.
gre_general.quote: GRE Required for all applicants; waived for WPI students and alumni.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Bioinformatics subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Pre-application supervisor requirement is not stated.

funding.value: WPI PhD students typically receive funding support through Research and/or Teaching Assistantships and/or Fellowships.
funding.quote: WPI PhD students typically receive funding support throughout their doctoral studies, through Research and/or Teaching Assistantships and/or Fellowships.

entry_route.value: Students must complete at least 90 credits beyond a bachelor's degree or at least 60 credits beyond a relevant M.S. degree.
entry_route.quote: Students pursuing the doctoral degree in BCB must complete a minimum of 90 credits of relevant work beyond the bachelor’s degree; or a minimum of 60 credits beyond the M.S. degree if the student possesses a relevant M.S. degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or a closely related field.

toefl_min.value: For PhD applicants, minimum TOEFL is 100.
toefl_min.quote: For PhD applicants, a TOEFL minimum score of 100 (internet based) or an IELTS band score of 7.5 is required.

ielts_min.value: For PhD applicants, minimum IELTS is 7.5.
ielts_min.quote: For PhD applicants, a TOEFL minimum score of 100 (internet based) or an IELTS band score of 7.5 is required.
